text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh? That's—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah! Big sisteerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Knight's... wait, the Time 
Traveler's? Eh, whatever, Big Sis Golshi!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, if it isn't the Space Federation 
VIP girl all the way from the M76 Nebula!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided what to do with Earth? 
Personally, I'd like you to hold off on 
blowing up the planet for a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fret not! Thanks to Big Sis Golshi's 
desperate plea bearing fruit, Earth has 
been granted a semi-permanent reprieve!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That's brilliant!! Looks like 
I've gone and saved the world once again!

...The mysterious girl calling herself a 
princess, whom I met in this park before.

As usual, I seem to be strangely on the 
same wavelength as Gold Ship, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hey, what've you got there?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah... This notebook? Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I like to think about 
things. Like, what if the world were like 
this, or what if I were this kind of 
person... all sorts of things."

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I only thought about things on 
my own... but thanks to my big sisters, I 
can dive into so many worlds of 
imagination—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, you know, I've been able 
to think deeper and deeper! To the point 
where I can write down this much...!!

The notebook the young girl showed me was 
filled with worlds and stories that 
sparked excitement just by reading 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
—You know, someday I'll bring this to 
life! Whether it's a manga, a movie, or a 
novel, I don't know, but... Someday, I'll 
definitely share my excitement with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh... Y-You...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yoooouuuuu!! What's that about!? That's 
the fuuuunniest thing I've ever heard!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Once it's finished, I'll definitely 
let my big sisters know—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, make sure to get 
super excited, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. That setting sun's still 
stinging my eyes, damn it...

Even after the young girl waved and ran 
off, Gold Ship continued gazing in the 
direction she had gone—
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to her work.

I'm really looking forward to seeing her 
work.
I wonder if we'll meet at this park again.

You've got me wanting to create something 
too

It makes me want to create something of my 
own, too.

text_block_list.text:
Even after the young girl waved and ran 
off, Gold Ship continued gazing in the 
direction she had gone—
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to her work.

I'm really looking forward to seeing her 
work.
I wonder if we'll meet at this park again.

You've got me wanting to create something 
too

It makes me want to create something of my 
own, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, totally! If they make a movie out 
of it, maybe we can star in it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The one written on the first page seemed 
totally doable to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's our origin story. She's the 
princess, and I'm the Golden Knight. 
You're my beauty mark."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're on an adventure to restore the 
devastated "Platinum Land" back into the 
beautiful country it once was.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
After facing many hardships along the way, 
my right beauty mark grew, until 
eventually, ray guns sprouted from both my 
hands—
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can grow one...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't make such a pathetic face!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Run full speed ahead straight to the most 
thrilling conclusion! AHAHAHAHA!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hate to say it, but ain't that gonna 
be tough?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean 'why'? Isn't it 
obvious—
(THUD... BOOM!!)

Suddenly, a massive object engulfed the 
sky... A blinding light so intense you 
couldn't even keep your eyes open! And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man A
text_block_list.text: Good grief. Caught you, Milady!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is time for study. Let us 
return—to our "Planet"!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeees. ...Fufu, but that was super fun!!
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Looks like they took off.

Together with Gold Ship, I watched the 
silhouette vanish with a twinkle into the 
far evening sky...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's this, what's this? Do we have 
another delightful author gracing us with 
their presence!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, ahem! The Great Literary Master 
Gol-Gol shall hear you out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Speak your mind and share your ideas to 
your heart's content!

Since she asked, I spoke whatever came to 
mind, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmmmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, absolutely splendid! This is 
what it truly means to witness sheer 
talent!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If countless grape gummies rained down 
from the sky in the opening scene, it 
would be even more perfect!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and then the forest writhed, the moon 
transformed into a regular 
hepta-conta-dihedron, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
However, all of these anomalies were 
merely the prologue...!!

"...Though I got swept up in Gold Ship's 
pace in the end, it turned out to be a 
strangely creative time."
